title: The accepting computation only
notes: The same palindrome machine with the search hidden: the run says how many configurations the search explored, then shows only the computation that accepts, one move at a time. Switch Options to every branch to see the guesses that failed.
ops: start q0; accept q0 q3; q0 eps, eps -> q1 $; q1 a, eps -> q1 a; q1 b, eps -> q1 b; q1 eps, eps -> q2 eps; q2 a, a -> q2 eps; q2 b, b -> q2 eps; q2 eps, $ -> q3 eps
